top_stories.title: BharatGen Launches Patram 1.5, a 7B Vision-Language Model for Document Processing

top_stories.title: IBM quantum computer solves problem classical computers can’t in just 15 minutes
top_stories.description: IBM and University of Chicago researchers have demonstrated that a quantum computer can complete an extraordinarily complex calculation in just 15 minutes, beyond the practical reach of leading classical computing methods. A novel error-detection technique also allows scientists to establish confidence in the accuracy of the results, overcoming a major hurdle in quantum computing.

top_stories.title: Amazon acquires key assets of AI startup Decart for reported $7.5B
top_stories.description: Amazon.com Inc. today announced plans to hire the technical staff of startup Decart.AI Inc. and acquire its core technology. The company didn’t disclose the terms of the deal. However, sources told Bloomberg that Amazon is paying about $7.5 billion. That’s nearly twice the valuation Decart reportedly received after its most recent funding round in May.
